title: This Is What ‘11 Out of 10’ Drunk Driving Looks Like
description:
Upside-down sunglasses and jumbled ABCs are the result of what one Ohio woman would call being “11 out of 10” drunk. When a Marysville officer pulled behind 40-year-old Hillary Hutchinson in a convenience store drive-thru, he witnessed an irate argument between her and an employee that prompted further investigation. What happened next baffled officers. Hutchinson was arrested and later pleaded guilty to one charge of operating a motor vehicle while impaired.
